retained_from_plan.kb_hold_volume_ok_reason: Required by the hold-score contract and the single-stock explanation to distinguish unknown volume from a negative score.

concept_fields.kb_concepts: nullable string: exact names joined by 、 from the bound observed F10 snapshot
concept_fields.kb_concept_count: nullable int8: count of those exact names; unknown collection remains null

concept_time: Only the latest bound source-date row receives the current F10 snapshot; all earlier rows remain null. Capture time and source hash are recorded separately; this is observation-time context and is not historical PIT data.
preservation: The full same-generation paired selector/backtest, all original formula fields, original 22 drawing results, and history audit assets remain intact. The display projection is never a driver, model, trading or global-current input.
